description: Department of Elections - Vacated the Offices of Member of Nuwara Eliya Pradeshiya Sabha by Mr. Kathiravel Sivapragasam Sachithananthan and Mr. Ambaladevan Nagarajah
reasoning: This gazette contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that two members of the Nuwara Eliya Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in their political party (Up-Country People's Front). This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) for matters concerning electoral commission decisions and declarations about elected representatives.
